menu.title: Fitness Menu
menu.descr: The Fitness menu is a new approach to cooking: more fresh vegetables and fruits. A product for active and healthy people. It is a completely new product with an optimal price and high quality!

menu.title: Lean Menu
menu.descr: The Lean menu is a careful selection of ingredients: a complete absence of animal products, milk from almonds, oats, coconut, or buckwheat, the right amount of protein from tofu, and imported vegetarian steaks.

menu.title: Premium Menu
menu.descr: In the Premium menu, we use not only beautiful packaging design but also high-quality food preparation. Red fish, seafood, and fruits - restaurant-style dining without going to a restaurant!
